summary: Mountain biker lost and injured (hand injury) on the Sunnyside Trail before 4 Corners; the subject had ridden an electric motorcycle up the trail and crashed, unable to ride further. MRA deployed from Hunter Creek Valley, made contact ~4:53pm, and escorted the subject out; subject self-transported for care. Forwarded to USFS.
location: Sunnyside Trail before 4 Corners, Hunter Creek Valley
notes: Post header dates mission July 19, 2020 (call 3:30pm); the body text says 'June 19th' once, an obvious typo for July. Fall/crash with hand injury.
